entries.name: Accounting
entries.description: Invoices, expenses and a VAT and income summary for any period, kept as plain local data. Operate it in plain language; the books are the app, and they change as the agent works.

entries.name: Blank
entries.description: The smallest working agent that can grow itself. Add plugins, or ask the builder inside to build them.

entries.name: GTD Planner
entries.description: Getting Things Done - capture, triage, next actions, waiting for, someday/maybe, reference and a calendar, grown from the blank canvas.

entries.name: Music
entries.description: A browser drum machine you play by talking to it - 8 or 16 steps, four synthesized tracks, tempo, saved patterns. No audio files; the drum machine is the app, and it changes as the agent works.

entries.name: Order Desk
entries.description: Customer emails in, orders out. The agent reads each email in any language and turns it into an order; stock is reserved or backordered, large orders wait for approval, shipping writes the delivery note and emails the customer.

entries.name: Organizer
entries.description: To-dos, a calendar and meeting booking that refuses overlaps. The builder inside extends it with whatever your day needs.

entries.name: Clearpath Audit
entries.description: An accessibility audit and assistive-preview console: sample findings filtered by priority, a live sample page with the affected component outlined, high-contrast, larger-text and focus-outline previews, remediation that is applied to the preview, and a re-run score. A triage concept, not a conformance check.

entries.name: An app that builds itself
entries.description: A small app with an offline agent and live plugin install: ask for a feature and the agent writes it into the running app, through the door. Development only: production leaves the agent out.

entries.name: Orbit API Console
entries.description: An API console: browse endpoints, fill in parameters or a request body, send a request to a local fixture API that validates and creates like the real one, read the response, and copy JavaScript, Python or Go snippets.

entries.name: Restorepoint
entries.description: A backup operations and recovery-planning console: protected workloads, a recovery timeline with integrity status, backup schedules, retention policies, a restore plan with preflight checks and a simulated restore run. Nothing real is read or restored.

entries.name: Blockscope Explorer
entries.description: A read-only blockchain explorer over a synthetic testnet: a block ledger with finality, search by height, hash or label, transaction pages with decoded event logs, address pages, contract events filtered by name and time range, and a saved watchlist. Everything is demo data.

entries.name: Chat
entries.description: An AI chat app: the answer streams token by token from an OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek by default), history in SQLite, a Stop button. Closed in production until it has an access token.

entries.name: Cloud Costs
entries.description: A FinOps cost explorer: monthly spend per provider and service from CSV exports, with forecasts, budgets and alerts.

entries.name: Northstar GRC
entries.description: A governance workbench: a control register over three frameworks with evidence freshness, an evidence review (accept, request a refresh, mark an exception), a risk watchlist with treatments and a recalculating posture strip, audit actions and an exportable review. Illustrative data; no certification claimed.

entries.name: CSV Explorer
entries.description: A local-first data workbench: import a CSV, read its column profile, filter and sort the rows, chart a column and save views.

entries.name: Federary Network
entries.description: A federation administration console: a topology map of fictional instances with trust edges and health, an instance profile with policy, identity assertion and handshake, inbound and outbound federation requests, a moderation queue, trust rules that can stop an approval, and reversible recorded decisions.

entries.name: Deploy Board
entries.description: A release operations console: deployments per service and environment, a chronological event feed and an incident board with a timeline.

entries.name: Canvasmith Desktop
entries.description: A desktop-style design workspace: a project of files, an artboard drawn from layers at a chosen zoom, an inspector with checked property edits, layer ordering, tools that add layers, and simulated exports with an activity log.

entries.name: Meshwatch
entries.description: A distributed-systems console: a Raft cluster's topology map, node health, quorum, the append-only commit log, replica lag and failover drills that move the leader.

entries.name: Flight Logbook
entries.description: A pilot logbook: 486:35 total time, 72:20 this year across 43 flights, 318:10 PIC, 12:45 in the last 90 days, a flight table with aircraft and role filters, route detail, an experience summary and CSV export.

entries.name: Sensepath Lab
entries.description: An interaction research workbench: six simulated input modalities (speech, gesture, eye tracking, alternative input, haptics, a BCI concept), a scenario with a calibration, a deterministic task simulation with synthetic timing events, and saved observations to compare. No sensor is accessed.

entries.name: Relaycraft
entries.description: An integration studio: connectors and connections, a pipeline canvas of source, transform and destination, field mappings with sample-record preview, and a deterministic sync simulation with run history.

entries.name: Lab Notebook
entries.description: A research notebook: three notebooks and 23 experiments, an append-only record with measurements, a chart, observations, attachments, audit history, an exact unit converter and a CSV data table.

entries.name: The Foundry
entries.description: A curated package atlas: search and filter libraries and frameworks, read their metadata and version history, copy an install command, and assemble a local stack with warnings and a manifest preview.

entries.name: Link Shortener
entries.description: A branded short-link workspace: 39 links on three domains, a create composer with unique slugs, 28,491 sample clicks, a 30-day trend, referrer and country breakdowns, and a working redirect.

entries.name: LingoDesk
entries.description: A translation-management and CAT workbench: target locales, source and target segments with draft, review and approved states, a glossary and translation-memory suggestions, and local QA checks for placeholders, missing translations, terminology and length. No translation service is contacted.

entries.name: Maintenance Log
entries.description: An industrial maintenance control room: 18 machines, 12 open work orders (4 awaiting parts, 3 overdue), 6.4 hours of downtime this month, asset profiles, and work orders closed only with a dated note and downtime.

entries.name: Pulsebus
entries.description: An event-bus explorer: browse topics and consumer groups, read a message stream with delivery and retry state, inspect JSON payloads, publish schema-validated synthetic events, replay and manage the dead-letter queue.

entries.name: Gatehouse
entries.description: An API-gateway control plane: a route registry, an ordered middleware pipeline per route, upstream services, request traces from a policy simulation, and a route-policy draft that is applied to the pipeline on purpose.

entries.name: Mobiary
entries.description: A mobile journal companion: a phone preview with Home, Capture, Activity and Profile screens, quick capture of notes, voice-memo and photo placeholders, home-screen modules you can switch, a daily focus with small goals, and compact and quiet preferences.

entries.name: Moodboard
entries.description: A spatial direction board: six draggable objects, three reference images, a palette rail, layers, an asset library, board settings and a JSON export.

entries.name: Notes, in a window
entries.description: A multi-user notes app (sign-up, log-in, search, SQLite with migrations) that opens in its own desktop window as well as in the browser.

entries.name: Swarmdrop
entries.description: A peer-to-peer transfer room: a chunk availability map with rarest-first requests, synthetic peers with rate and latency, a pausable simulation with a corrupt-copy retry, integrity verification and a completion receipt, and rooms you can create or join by code. Nothing is transferred.

entries.name: Photo Gallery
entries.description: A charcoal editorial photo archive: 4,281 seeded photographs in four albums, a masonry library with search and paging, favourites, sharing, an offline lightbox and a validated upload form.

entries.name: Productivity Hub
entries.description: A calm personal workbench: quick capture and an inbox to triage, one daily focus, next actions, notes with linked tasks and a week calendar that warns before two events overlap.

entries.name: Prompt Lab
entries.description: A prompt engineering workbench: a reusable prompt library with variables, side-by-side model runs and quick evaluations, on the model you configure.

entries.name: Remote Relay
entries.description: A remote-computing workspace: saved SSH-style connections, simulated terminal sessions with allowlisted demo commands, a transfer queue with file metadata and a session audit log.

entries.name: Robot Missions
entries.description: A map-first robot mission planner: five robots, five missions with ordered waypoints, run/pause/reset simulation, telemetry history and an event log. Simulation only.

entries.name: Runlevel
entries.description: A runtime operations desk: hosts and their managed processes with a simulated restart, a runtime compatibility matrix, and rollout drafts checked against it with history and roll-back.

entries.name: Sensor Dashboard
entries.description: An IoT operations dashboard: 12 devices with 11 online, 4,320 readings an hour, one critical and one warning alert, live sensor cards, a 24h/7d history, device details, threshold editing, an alert log and a validated HTTP ingest contract.

entries.name: Morrow Lab
entries.description: A simulation workbench: tune a thermal chamber's boundary conditions, run a deterministic local model, compare response traces and keep named parameter snapshots.

entries.name: Small CRM
entries.description: A relationship-first CRM for a small sales team: a deals pipeline with an inspector, contacts, company profiles, a follow-up queue and a pipeline report, composed from Cordis plugins.

entries.name: Snippet Manager
entries.description: A developer's snippet vault: 128 reusable code snippets with tags, variables, syntax-coloured previews, search and collections.

entries.name: Vaultline
entries.description: A storage console: pool capacity and health, volumes created against free capacity, object buckets with browsable metadata, and a snapshot ledger with retention.

entries.name: System Monitor
entries.description: This machine's memory, disks and heaviest processes on one live page, with a kill-list that asks before it ends a program.

entries.name: Termforge
entries.description: A terminal workspace simulator: workspaces with tabs, a strict command allowlist answered from fixtures, a command deck and task launcher, saved snippets, command history and recall, and a session status panel. It never runs a host process.

entries.name: Uptime Checker
entries.description: A lightweight availability monitor: hosts and URLs checked on a schedule, with status history, response times and incidents.

entries.name: Vehicle Log
entries.description: An owner-oriented garage logbook: a Volvo XC60 with 86,420 km, four service records, ten fuel entries, insurance, tax and inspection costs, reminders, a EUR 2,184 year and a EUR 0.31 lifetime cost per km.

entries.name: Hyperplane
entries.description: A virtualization console: pick a host, search and filter the machine inventory, start, pause, stop and snapshot machines under a lifecycle state machine with capacity guards, and provision new ones.

entries.name: Vulnerability Tracker
entries.description: A security-operations console: 24 assets and 128 open findings with severity and status filters, a finding inspector, an evidence-gated remediation trail, reports, policies and JSON/CSV exports.

entries.name: Web Analytics
entries.description: A privacy-conscious website analytics console: a tracking snippet, page-view events in, and a daily dashboard of visitors, sources, pages and conversions.

entries.name: Pagefoundry
entries.description: A website builder: a site of pages built from blocks, a live browser-framed preview with selectable sections, an inspector for headline, background, width and visibility with a contrast check, preview mode for desktop and mobile, and simulated publishes with warnings.

entries.name: Luma Space
entries.description: An XR scene composer: a stylised 3D viewport with AR, VR and MR preview modes, an object hierarchy with parent-child transforms in metres, a transform inspector, spatial anchors, a simulated interaction preview and scene validation. Nothing is an XR session.
